turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
PM

I know timing matters with cancellations. There is not a guaranteed cancellation window, so the best thing is to request it as soon as possible after placing the order. If the order has not shipped yet, it may still be eligible for cancellation. If it is already processing or on the way, it usually cannot be canceled and you would need to start a return once it arrives. If you want me to check your order, please log in first.
